notToBeConfusedWith.name: Maraschino liqueur
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The clear cherry-pit liqueur this cherry was traditionally preserved in and is named after; a modern jarred cherry is sugar-brined rather than liqueur-steeped and the two are not interchangeable.

forms.label: In syrup, drained
forms.sourceNote: Maraschino cherries, canned, drained. Public domain. The record reports per-100g figures only; the 6 g per-cherry weight is a rounded average taken from several commercial jars' own stated serving sizes rather than from this record. No density is carried: the cherry is dropped in whole rather than poured.
